title: RRM to Attend Special Joint State Representatives and Additional Director General’s Conference 2026 of NCC in Guwahati
body_text: The Special Joint State Representatives and Additional Director General’s Conference of National Cadet Corps led by Director General NCC, Lt. General Virendra Vats, will be held in Guwahati on October 15, 2026 to deliberate on issues concerning the NCC in the North Eastern Region (NER), West Bengal and Sikkim. The conference will be chaired by Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth and will bring together senior representatives from the Ministry of Defence, NCC and the State Governments of the participating States. The conference will focus on key issues relating to the expansion of NCC, cadet welfare, training, institutional strengthening and administrative challenges. It will also provide a platform for enhanced coordination between the NCC and State Governments to explore collaborative initiatives for increasing the reach, effectiveness and impact of the organisation. The NCC plays a significant role in youth development, nation-building and community engagement through its Social Service and Community Development (SSCD) activities. With a presence in more than 99% of districts across India, it continues to contribute to the development of disciplined, responsible and motivated citizens. It functions under the shared responsibilities of the Central and State Governments. **** SR/Ruchi
